entries.note: Received at COSHIP's Vancouver warehouse. The page translates it as Received at warehouse.
Left for the flight, at VANCOUVER AIRPORT.
Arrived, at INCHEON AIRPORT on COSHIP's own row. Korea Post's rows use the same word when a mail centre or post office receives the parcel.
COSHIP's first row in VANCOUVER, awaiting the flight, in place of 입고 완료 on newer parcels.
Left on the flight, at VANCOUVER AIRPORT.
Korean customs: the flight's arrival report filed.
Korean customs: the arrival report accepted.
Korean customs: the inbound cargo manifest filed.
Korean customs: the inbound cargo manifest reviewed.
Korean customs: the manifest's flight details corrected.
Korean customs: the unloading declaration accepted.
Korean customs: the parcel's customs list filed for clearance.
Korean customs: brought into the bonded area for clearance.
Korean customs: the customs list reviewed and the parcel cleared.
Korean customs: released from the bonded area to Korea Post.
Korea Post's receipt at its international mail logistics centre after clearance, not the parcel's first acceptance.
Sent on by a Korea Post mail centre or post office.
Korea Post's delivering post office prepares the round. The row names the postman after it, which is never read.
Delivered by Korea Post. The row adds (배달) and who took the parcel, which are never read.
